title: Installment Charges Counted Against a TRICARE Prime First Installment
content:
**Clause.** The installment charges that count against the first installment of a fee-bearing TRICARE Prime enrollment are read from its fee account:

- where an installment charge on the account was posted after the application date, every installment charge on the account counts against it;
- where none was and the application was received before the effective date, the installment charge beginning on the effective date counts against it;
- otherwise the installment charges posted on the application date count against it.

## Cases (hypothetical; application received 25 March, effective date 1 April)

| Charges on the account | Counted against the first installment |
|---|---|
| 32.51 posted 25 March beginning 1 April, and 65.02 posted 2 April | both: 97.53 (a charge was posted after the application date) |
| 32.51 posted 25 March beginning 1 April only | the charge beginning on the effective date: 32.51 |

With the application received on 10 April instead, and only charges posted that day, the charges posted on 10 April count.
